description: Bring Your Own Key SMTP relay. Connect your own SMTP server (Gmail, SendGrid, Mailgun, SES, etc.) and send email through the UnitySVC gateway; you bring the credentials, UnitySVC handles auth, routing, and metering. This is a multi-channel service: the free `byok` channel relays every call to one SMTP server you store once as customer secrets, while the metered `plus` channel lets you run many relays under a single account — each enrollment binds its own host/port/username plus a named password secret and is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` address. See “How to use this service” for both channels.
name: smtp-relay

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own SMTP
